basic_steps: Form two parallel rows facing each other
Sway the body rhythmically from front to back
Grasp a light sword in the right or left hand
Raise the sword and lower it (top to bottom) in sync with the drum beat
Repeat the poetic verses chanted by the lead poet
Gather around the central flag-bearer for the finale
teaching.level_notes: Accessible to all ages and social classes; focus is on group synchronization rather than individual virtuosity.
teaching.rhythm: Successive drum strikes, starting with large drums followed by smaller ones
